ScreenSaverDefaults.doc: A class that defines a set of methods for saving and restoring user defaults for screen savers.

ScreenSaverView.doc: An abstract class that defines the interface for subclassers to interact with the screen saver infrastructure.

+defaultsForModuleWithName:.doc: Returns a screen saver defaults instance that reads and writes defaults for the specified module.

+backingStoreType.doc: Returns the type of backing store you want for your screen saver’s window.

+performGammaFade.doc: Indicates whether to perform a gradual screen fade when the system starts and stops your screen saver’s animation.

-animateOneFrame.doc: Advances the screen saver’s animation by a single frame.

-initWithFrame:isPreview:.doc: Creates a newly allocated screen saver view with the specified frame rectangle and preview information.

-startAnimation.doc: Activates the periodic timer that animates the screen saver.

-stopAnimation.doc: Deactivates the timer that advances the animation.

animating.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the screen saver is animating.

animationTimeInterval.doc: The time interval between animation frames.

configureSheet.doc: The window that contains the controls to configure the screen saver.

hasConfigureSheet.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the screen saver has an associated configuration sheet.

preview.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the screen saver view is set to a size suitable for previewing its content.
